author: harlowboo
body:
Hey. My username is harlowboo. I think I should be unbanned, because I wasn't hacking or anything, There was a bad lag for everyone on one of the games and I was fighting one of your staff and I killed them so they automatically banned me. I haven't been on your server for about a year now, maybe more. I miss the server a lot and I used to be always on it. I don't have hacks, I don't know how to use them. Plz can you unban me. I didn't do anything wrong. The person who banned me is named dddddddddddd no joke and I got banned for apparently Hacking - Kill Aura. I was apparently banned February 8th 2015 at 9:05:36 but I wasn't even on your server at that time. It was deleted so I think they might of put something in wrong. If the person was called ddddddddddd then I think someone probably hacked your server and banned me? idk


As I said.. Plz unban me; I done nothing wrong and I think its unfair to accuse me of hacking and not asking me, to suddenly just ban me.
